'''Chardaan''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that lay at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was orbited by the [[Chardaan Shipyards]].<ref name="DS" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Chardaan was the headquarters for the [[Sixteenth Army|Republic 16th Sector Army]] and the capital of the [[Pallis Oversector]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The planet thus became the capital of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Coy]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="SoR" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] managed to infiltrate the planet.<ref name="SoR" /> The Rebels used these yards to build some of the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] used in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Squadron 1}}</ref>

Later, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] used the same shipyards to build not only A-wings, but [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], and [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wings]]. The shipyards were [[Battle of the Chardaan Shipyards|attacked]] and destroyed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="DS" />
